```yaml
name: Publish Fern Docs

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions/setup-rust@v2
        with:
          rust-version: stable

      - name: Install fern-cli
        run: cargo install fern-cli

      - name: Generate Fern docs preview
        run: fern generate --docs --preview

      - name: Commit and push docs
        uses: EndBug/add-and-commit@v9
        with:
          add: docs/
          message: "Update Fern docs preview"
          new_branch: docs
          push: true
          cwd: .
```
